svg.title: Stronger: Mobile · Android
svg.desc: Stronger (android · ios · web). Strength-training diary with a Strava-style social feed. Built solo, from the Flutter UI to the REST API. Features: live-logging, rest-timer, plans, heatmap, muscle-map, progress-stats, social-feed. Architecture: app/ Flutter · BLoC · sqflite; sync/ offline queue · retries · tombstones; api/ Node.js · Express · PostgreSQL · Docker. 1,200+ Flutter tests, 350+ backend tests, GitHub Actions CI. Status: Google Play release in preparation.
